name: kpost-admin-testbench
description: Playwright API test automation framework for the KPOST Admin Module API

scripts.audit:vectors: tsc scripts/audit-vectors.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --outDir .audit-build && node .audit-build/audit-vectors.js
scripts.scorecard: tsc reporters/generate-scorecard.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --outDir .scorecard-build && npx playwright test --list --reporter=json > .scorecard-build/test-list.json && node .scorecard-build/generate-scorecard.js .scorecard-build/test-list.json
scripts.dashboard:push: tsc reporters/dashboard-ingest.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --outDir .dashboard-build && node .dashboard-build/dashboard-ingest.js
scripts.bugzilla:file: tsc reporters/dashboard-bugzilla.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --outDir .bugzilla-build && node .bugzilla-build/dashboard-bugzilla.js
